picks.title: InfiMaker K1 is a desktop CNC mill that turns 2D images into 3D objects with AI
picks.excerpt: The InfiMaker K1 is a 5-axis desktop CNC mill that uses AI to turn a flat 2D image into a millable 3D model, aimed at makers with no machining background.
picks.rationale: Highest actionability for a design audience: an AI 2D-to-3D path straight into a 5-axis desktop mill collapses the sketch-to-physical-part loop for people who never learned CAM.

picks.title: I ran the same local LLM on an RTX 5070 and integrated graphics, and the results were beyond my expectations
picks.excerpt: Running Gemma 3 4B on an RTX 5070 laptop versus an integrated-Radeon machine showed near-identical output quality, undercutting the case for dedicated AI hardware.
picks.rationale: A hands-on benchmark that changes a real purchasing decision: if output quality holds on integrated graphics, the 'AI laptop' upsell stops being necessary for local model work.

picks.title: Microsoft releases Windows 11 August 2026 Patch Tuesday update
picks.excerpt: KB5121003 lets Copilot+ PC owners remove the on-device image-generation AI component on its own, a first for unbundling Windows' local AI stack.
picks.rationale: First time Windows lets you strip out a single local AI component instead of the whole stack - a concrete new lever over disk, privacy and what actually runs on a work machine.

picks.title: Abbott partners with Google Health for AI-powered glucose monitoring
picks.excerpt: Abbott's Lingo continuous glucose monitor now feeds the Google Health app, which turns the sensor stream into AI-driven lifestyle recommendations.
picks.rationale: A named sensor maker handing its raw stream to a platform AI is the clearest template yet for how hardware and software split roles in consumer health product design.

picks.title: Latest iOS 27 Beta Expands Siri AI Voice Customization
picks.excerpt: iOS 27 beta 5 adds Pace and Expressivity controls plus eleven voices to Siri AI, generated on-device and limited to iPhone 17 Pro and iPhone Air hardware.
picks.rationale: Pace and Expressivity turn assistant voice into a user-tunable design surface, and the hardware gate shows how on-device generation still fragments the experience.
